title: Apply Schema
description: As a user exporting a diagram, I want the backend to apply DDL to PostgreSQL so that the diagram is realized as a database schema.
acceptanceCriteria: Given an active connection and validated DDL, when the frontend calls the apply-schema endpoint after user confirmation, then the backend executes the DDL against the chosen schema and returns success or a descriptive error
And no existing objects are dropped

evidence: Backend route implemented: backend/src/routes/apply-schema.ts - POST /api/apply-schema endpoint with DDL execution, transaction management, statement_timeout, search_path configuration, and descriptive error handling
Backend types: backend/src/types/apply-schema.ts - Zod request schema and ApplySchemaResult type
Backend tests: backend/src/routes/apply-schema.test.ts - 24 tests all passing (confirmation check, transaction BEGIN/COMMIT, statement_timeout, search_path, safety rejection, rollback on failure)
DDL safety validator: backend/src/services/ddl-safety.ts - validates DDL rejects DROP/TRUNCATE/DELETE/destructive ALTER, allows CREATE and ALTER TABLE ADD CONSTRAINT/ADD COLUMN (42 tests passing)
DDL safety validator (alternative): backend/src/services/ddl-safety-validator.ts - complementary safety validation (23 tests passing)
Frontend API client: src/connection/ddlApi.ts - applyDDL function sending DDL with confirm flag to /api/apply-schema (5 tests passing)
Frontend component: src/components/DdlPreview.tsx - review dialog with confirmation checkbox before executing DDL (12 tests passing)
All backend tests: 177 passed, 17 skipped (integration tests need PostgreSQL) - run via docker run node:20-alpine npm test
All frontend tests: passed including DdlPreview and ddlApi tests - run via docker run node:20-alpine npm test
Typecheck: backend tsc --noEmit passed, frontend tsc passed
Docker commands: docker run --rm --init --cap-drop ALL --security-opt no-new-privileges --user $(id -u):$(id -g) -v $(pwd):/work -w /work node:20-alpine sh -c 'npm ci --ignore-scripts && npm test'
